# Tabu

> Tabu builds modern business websites and provides SEO, AEO and GEO services.

## Official website
- [Tabu](https://tabu.live/): Website design, development, hosting and maintenance.
- [SEO, AEO & GEO](https://tabu.live/#aeo): Local SEO, conversational content, structured data, brand entity clarity and crawler access.
- [Plans](https://tabu.live/#plans): Starter ₹18,000; Business ₹25,000 plus a retainer; Custom scoped individually.
- [Contact](https://tabu.live/#contact): Request an AI search audit or discuss a project.

## Service scope
Starter includes up to five pages, mobile-first design, a contact form, hosting, SSL and basic on-page SEO.
Business adds local SEO and Google Maps setup, AEO and GEO integration (llms.txt and FAQ schema), and monthly review and citation management.
Custom covers e-commerce or multi-location SEO, API integrations and dedicated AI search tracking.

## Accuracy
Search rankings, AI citations and recommendations are determined by third-party platforms and are not guaranteed. Confirm custom scope and retainer pricing directly with Tabu.
